title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - SLATargetPercentile
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/SLATargetPercentile. Percentage of frames the SLA metrics can be guaranteed. Subclass of QuantityKind per the Gaia-X ontology, with no properties of its own beyond those inherited (applicableUnit, quantityValue); inherited properties are documented on the QuantityKind model and not repeated here. Per the source ontology's own validation rule, applicableUnit must equal https://qudt.org/vocab/unit/PERCENT for instances of this class (not enforced structurally in this JSON Schema).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SLATargetPercentile'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
